title: Most elements of a professional IPS are missing: return objective, ranges, rebalancing policy, constraints, metrics, governance
problem: Against the CFA Institute's 2010 IPS elements, V5 has objectives, a risk paragraph, a hold-without-trading rule and a yearly review, but no return requirement, no stock range, no liquidity line, no eligible-securities constraint and no review trigger with a number. The most useful missing item is the return requirement: the payments need about 5.09% a year on $300k, and the 15 Oct holdings-basis ladder locks in about 5.13% (MODEL), so the payments need no growth asset.
